services.name: Home energy audit
services.guideLabel: What a home energy audit involves
services.blurb: An EnerGuide evaluation by an NRCan-registered energy advisor: blower door test, full house inspection, an energy rating and a ranked upgrade list.

services.name: Blower door test
services.guideLabel: The blower door test, step by step
services.blurb: A calibrated fan depressurizes the house to measure air leakage and show where the leaks are.

services.name: Thermal imaging inspection
services.blurb: An infrared camera maps cold and warm surfaces to find missing insulation, thermal bridges and hidden moisture.
services.cost: Usually included with an evaluation; confirm

services.name: Heat loss calculation
services.blurb: A room-by-room CSA F280 calculation of heat loss at the local design temperature: the right way to size a heat pump or furnace.

services.name: Duct leakage testing
services.blurb: Pressure-tests ductwork and measures airflow at each register to find where heated air disappears.

services.name: Combustion safety test
services.guideLabel: The combustion safety and spillage check
services.blurb: Checks that furnaces, water heaters and fireplaces vent safely, especially before a house is tightened.
services.cost: Included with an evaluation when you have fuel-burning appliances

services.name: Ventilation and humidity assessment
services.blurb: Measures air exchange and humidity and checks that bath and kitchen fans actually move air outside.
services.cost: Included in an evaluation; HRV sizing may be extra

services.name: Attic insulation inspection
services.blurb: Insulation depth and condition, air bypasses and ventilation, plus red flags like vermiculite before anyone disturbs it.

services.name: Energy bill analysis
services.blurb: Twelve months of electricity and gas use, weather-normalized and split into heating and baseload: the baseline every savings estimate needs.
services.cost: Free to do yourself; part of an evaluation

services.name: Radon testing
services.blurb: A long-term test (at least three months, in the heating season) measures radon against Canada's 200 Bq/m³ guideline.

services.name: Carbon monoxide testing
services.blurb: CO alarms in the right places, plus a check that fuel-burning appliances vent safely.

services.name: Mold and air quality testing
services.guideLabel: The mold and indoor air quality guide
services.blurb: Air or surface sampling when you suspect hidden mold, paired with a hunt for the moisture that feeds it.

services.name: Asbestos and vermiculite testing
services.blurb: Lab analysis of samples from suspect insulation, tiles, plaster or duct wrap before renovation disturbs them.

services.name: Lead paint testing
services.blurb: Swab kits screen painted surfaces; a lab or an X-ray reading confirms before renovation disturbs old paint.

services.name: Well water testing
services.blurb: Bacteria testing at least once a year and periodic chemistry for homes on private wells.

services.name: Commercial energy audit
services.blurb: An engineering audit of an office, apartment, retail or industrial building, scoped to ASHRAE Standard 211 levels 1 to 3.
services.cost: Priced by building size and audit level
